body:
**Part 1 is fixed on main.** #378 merged as `12f9cdee05`. Re-measured against
merged main just now:

```
numeric preferred_term mentions:   0   (was 497)
"Original amount:" notes remaining: 0
```

We converged on the same defect from opposite ends — you from MIM's residual
triage, me from the four "anonymous" ingredients on the 000001 page. Your read
of it was right in every particular, including that all 497 were recoverable
without a re-scrape.

One correction to the diagnosis, from the root cause: the name in `notes` was
not the only thing lost. UTEX tables are
`# | Component | Amount | Stock Solution Concentration | Final Concentration`
and the fetcher read `cols[0]`/`cols[1]`, so it never read the Amount column at
all — the concentrations were absent, not misplaced, and `G_PER_L` was later
fabricated to fill the hole. So a remapping alone would have restored the names
onto invented concentrations. The re-fetch also recovered 419 stock/final
concentrations that had never been captured.

Result: 497/497 names restored, grounding 0% -> 84%, and 377 real quantified
concentrations replacing 497 fabricated `G_PER_L`.

**Part 2 is untouched and still present.** Current count on main, by
`preferred_term` starting or ending with an apostrophe:

| mentions | preferred_term |
|---:|---|
| 75 | `'Iron(III` |
| 13 | `'Fe(III` |
| 8 | `'Chromium(III` |
| 6 | `'(S` |
| 2 | `'Manganese(IV` |
| 2 | `'(9Z` |
| 2 | `'(R` |
| 1 | `'Cyanocob(III` |
| 1 | `'(R,R` |
| 1 | `'Nickel(II` |
| 1 | `Trace metals 'Gaffron\xad+Se'` |

**112 mentions, 11 distinct values, across 102 records** — slightly more than
the 121/24 in the issue because that figure covered both defects together, and
this scan is part 2 only. The last row is a different shape from the rest: a
plausible name carrying a soft hyphen (`\xad`), not a split repr.

Unlike part 1, this one is **not** recoverable from the records: `'Iron(III`
was `'Iron(III) citrate'` or similar before a `str(list)` was split on `,`, and
the tail is gone. It needs the upstream source, so it wants a different fix
from the UTEX repair — the source of these should be identified first
(they are not UTEX; the 99 UTEX records are now clean).

Suggest keeping this issue open for part 2 and treating part 1 as closed by
#378.

**Part 2 is fixed on main.** #391 merged as `e75a797bbf`. Re-measured against
merged main:

```
ingredient names damaged:  1   (was 112)
medium labels damaged:     0   (was 182)
original_names damaged:    0   (was 182)
colliding medium labels:   0   (was 4, covering 68 media)
```

Both parts of this issue are now closed by #378 and #391.

## The part that was not in the original report

Chasing the same bug through `_parse_media_insert` found damage to the media's
**own names**, which is worse than the ingredient damage. The parser cut at the
first parenthesis, which for these media removes exactly what distinguishes
them:

```
'Defined freshwater medium (CoSO4        <- 29 DISTINCT media, one string
  MEDIADB:416 = ... (CoSO4) + 100 mM Fe2O3 + 113.2 mM Acetate
  MEDIADB:418 = ... (CoSO4) + 20 mM Iron citrate + 113.2 mM Acetate
  MEDIADB:419 = ... (CoSO4) + 5 mM nitrate + 113.2 mM Acetate
```

Four such collisions covered 68 media. All distinct now.

I also had to correct my own earlier reply here: I said part 2 was "not
recoverable from the records". It was — `data/raw/mediadb/media_database.07Oct2015.sql`
is the authoritative dump and holds every name. 111 of 111 ingredient names
resolved with zero ambiguity, cross-checked against MediaDB's `chebi_ids`
column (which the resolution does not use), including the two most easily
swapped: `(R)-Lactate` -> CHEBI:42111 *(R)-lactic acid*, `(S)-Lactate` ->
CHEBI:422 *(S)-lactic acid*.

## The one remaining

`Trace metals 'Gaffron\xad+Se'` in `pcr_s11_medium.yaml`. Not truncation — a
real name carrying a soft hyphen (U+00AD) and an embedded quote, in a record
with no MediaDB medium id. Different defect; worth keeping this issue open for
it, or closing and filing it fresh.

## Follow-ups filed

- **#390** — `mediadb_importer.py` hardcodes four compounds as "corrupted". They
  were not corrupt upstream; that was the column-mapping bug. The patch covered
  4 of 14,797 compounds; the other 14,793 were shifted too.
- **#392** — `name`, the record slug, still encodes the truncated medium name
  for those 182 records. Left alone because the slug is used for matching and
  deduplication.

Closing: both defects are fixed, and so is the survivor named in the last comment. Re-checked on `main` at `41d4d39` by walking every entry in `data/normalized_yaml`, nested ones included.

- **Part 1, the field swap.** 0 numeric `preferred_term` mentions (was 497) and 0 `Original amount:` notes. Fixed by #378 (`12f9cdee05`).
- **Part 2, the split list repr.** 0 truncated fragments. Fixed by #391 (`e75a797bbf`). Only two `preferred_term` values still start or end with an apostrophe, and both are complete names with embedded quotes, not truncations:
  - `Trace metals 'Gaffron+Se'`, an ingredient of `pcr_s11_medium.yaml`;
  - `Metals ''44''`, the name of the solution record `mediadive_3800_Metals_44.yaml`.
- **The survivor.** The U+00AD soft hyphen in `Trace metals 'Gaffron+Se'` was #406. #409 (`2e4566eaad`) fixed it, and `pcr_s11_medium.yaml` now has 0 U+00AD characters.

**Outside this issue's scope.** Six MediaDive solution records still carry U+00AD in their own names, in both `preferred_term` and `term.label`. They are MediaDive solutions 6188, 6197, 6207, 6209, 6210 and 6224, for example `3N­BBM+V` in `mediadive_6188_…`. Another 57 occurrences sit in preparation text, in `description` and `preparation_notes`. #409 cleaned only TOGO component names.
